name: Bavva
description: Bavva was a planet in the Bavva system in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along a hyperspace route. Over several months during the Iron Blockade of the sector by the Galactic Empire, a merchant on Bavva was robbed several times. The merchant then offered payment for an experienced individual to provide them personal security.
